name: text-build
title: Text Build
description: Words enter one at a time while already-placed words physically reflow to stay centered — a growing line on the x axis or a growing stack on the y axis.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/text-build?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
